name: Orbital Sculpt Suite
summary: Compact sculpt workstation metadata for a floating orb edit target inside the universal viewport.

tools.label: Inflate
tools.description: Pushes the surface outward along the sampled brush normal.

tools.label: Carve
tools.description: Cuts inward along the brush normal for crater-like dents.

tools.label: Smooth
tools.description: Pulls noisy peaks back toward the sampled tangent plane.

tools.label: Pinch
tools.description: Slides surface points toward the stroke center for sharper ridges.
